Ludicolo

Water Grass

Hoenn · Generation 3

Ludicolo is a Water/Grass-type Carefree Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 55 kg. It evolves from Lombre. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (100), with a base stat total of 480.
